note: Per hero-role, per opening three items with 60+ players, both as the exact purchase order (ordered: true, core in order) and as the set in any order (ordered: false, core sorted): mostRun / laneMostRun / pairs = what players on the build run, and whether most of them run a different pick than the lane (a choice, not a win claim); n / w = players and wins; augments / eternals / crests = the picks those players ran, ranked by the edge rule with each option shrunk toward its own lane-wide rate plus the build gap (label Best / Leans / Toss-up / Most played / By games; rows carry games, wins and the shrunk win rate; few = too few games to lead); laneLead = the lane-wide lead; changes = this build's lead is a different pick with a clear (90%+) edge. next = the most bought fourth, fifth and sixth items among players who bought one in that slot (counts only).
